what_differs: The 09-01 sync confirms the Operator, Partner and Brand Ambassador record pages were handed over to the client. Per the project's status semantics, the matching tickets (for example WAGR-202, WAGR-203, WAGR-205, WAGR-234, WAGR-235, WAGR-236) should be in Client Review or later, but they are all still in 'Jumpr Review' (internal review). The last comment on WAGR-203 even says 'Not yet built'.
suggested_action: Move the handed-over page tickets to Client Review (or Done where client feedback is closed), and add a short status comment to WAGR-203/WAGR-205 to confirm what was built. Note that no WAGR issue is in 'Client Review' at all (137 are in Jumpr Review), so this is likely a project-wide status-usage gap for the Project Mgmt area to confirm.
